statusDetail: The target was reachable via curl GET (HTTP 200, 429,920 bytes), but Chrome/CDP evidence gathering could not complete: six initial primitive runs timed out, a retry ended with ECONNRESET, and another Chrome launch exited early. No page-quality verdicts or score are published.

page.notes: Rendered recon was blocked before page/template or route discovery. Representative multi-page coverage could not be selected.

checkOutcomes.method: Attempted browser prerequisite for planned rendered-page screenshot/DOM probe under the check condition.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw-CDP browser prerequisite failed: six concurrent screenshot/DOM/layout/evaluate attempts each timed out after Chrome launched, a subsequent screenshot attempt reset the CDP socket, and the headers attempt reported Chrome exited before listening. The rendered page and interactions were therefore unavailable; curl GET succeeded, so this is a browser-execution/environment blocker rather than evidence about page quality.
checkOutcomes.reason: Chrome could not sustain a CDP session for https://vk.com in this run, so direct rendered or interactive evidence could not be gathered.
